items.title_orig: The Smashing Pumpkins: Overrated, Underrated, or Properly Rated?
items.article_text:
Watching The Smashing Pumpkins blistering set at Lollapalooza (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CauHljQhalw) made me think they had been underrated for a long time, but then my son told me they are pretty popular with Gen Z, and their streaming numbers seem to back that up. Given Bill’s love of ‘90s bands, where do The Smashing Pumpkins fit:
 Overrated: Billy Corgan can be insufferable, he has a weird voice, and can’t get along with his band mates. They only have three great albums, and those were their first three.
 Underrated: Even at their peak, they sold far fewer albums than bands like Green Day, Red Hot Chili Peppers, or even The Offspring. Their sound has held up better than pretty much all their contemporaries, influencing tons of 2000s bands. Their post 2000s work is pretty good. H
